verdict.rationale: Otter documents an 'Otter API & Webhooks' feature in pricing tiers and a Public API for custom integrations, plus a live MCP server for pulling transcripts/summaries/action items into AI tools, but the runtime probe shows the MCP endpoint is OAuth-gated and both API/MCP access are restricted to Enterprise workspaces (contact account manager), not self-serve; no public OpenAPI/swagger docs were found (all 404). Missing for 10: publicly discoverable API reference docs, evidence of self-serve API key generation for individual/non-enterprise users, and independent confirmation of successful script-based pulls.
